_comment: Slice download contract (GET /api/v1/debug/slice). messages are the 400 texts in check order; the first rule a request breaks answers ({source}, {available}, {event} are filled in; available is the sorted list of the worker's sources for the scope joined with ", ", or none). validation_cases run a query (text values; every other parameter, a token too, is ignored) against the sources in available (a case may give its own); error null means the request is accepted. A cluster-scope request on a worker with no cluster source skips the source check, and the route answers 409 after every 400 check. filters_cases map a query to the filters column of the slice table: sorted compact JSON, UTF-8 not escaped, max_rows, output and sources always, every other filter only when given, events sorted without repeats, sources the sorted sources read (all available ones when none is asked for). file_names map a slice to its attachment name (UTC bounds, the fraction of a second dropped; the sanitized cluster, default when empty). ddl holds the two slice tables. limits pin the build limits; a limit marks the file truncated and never answers an error. A batch ends at batch_rows rows or chunk_bytes text bytes, whichever comes first, and the size limits are checked after each batch. from and to are epoch seconds from min_epoch to max_epoch (9999-12-31 23:59:59 UTC). open_bytes_full answers a request while finished slices still being sent hold open_max_bytes.
messages: from and to must be finite numbers of epoch seconds
to must be greater than from
the time range is at most 168h
scope must be worker or cluster
source '{source}' is not available on this worker; available: {available}
partition must be a whole number from 0 to 2147483647
offset_from and offset_to must be whole numbers from -9223372036854775808 to 9223372036854775807
offset_from must not be greater than offset_to
events must name at most 40 event types
event '{event}' is not a recorder event type
label_key must be 1 to 128 characters without " or \
max_rows must be a whole number from 1 to 1000000

ddl.slice:
CREATE TABLE slice (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
    schema      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at  TEXT    NOT NULL,
    scope       TEXT    NOT NULL,
    worker      TEXT,
    cluster     TEXT,
    from_ts     REAL    NOT NULL,
    to_ts       REAL    NOT NULL,
    filters     TEXT    NOT NULL,
    rows        INTEGER NOT NULL,
    truncated   TEXT,
    notes       TEXT    NOT NULL
)
ddl.slice_sources:
CREATE TABLE slice_sources (
    kind    TEXT    NOT NULL,
    name    TEXT,
    worker  TEXT,
    rows    INTEGER NOT NULL
)
